description:
What this is. A ticket is the permission for one employee to go to the clinic on a given day. Issue one here, or it is issued for you when a Medical Gate Pass is approved.

What happens next. When the employee taps in at the clinic, the ticket turns Visited by itself. A ticket nobody used turns Expired the day after it runs out.
name: Issue Clinic Tickets
title: Clinic Ticket — who may go to the clinic
